levels.name: Ground level: station building (Asemakatu 2, built 1981) and the platforms: edge platform 1 (station side), island platform 3/4, platform 6 (east)
levels.note: No signposted level name found. Väylävirasto: passengers use the edge platforms and the island platform between tracks 3 and 4; in the 2023–2024 'Pieksämäen asemajärjestelyt' works track 2 was removed, the island 3/4 widened, low platforms raised, canopies, lighting and lifts renewed. Digitraffic still classes platform 4 as matala (0.265 m) while the others are korkea; VR calls all platforms high (korkeat laiturit).
levels._source: Väylävirasto, "Ratapihaselvitykset: Pieksämäki" (Väyläviraston julkaisuja 58/2026, published 2026-08-10, CC BY 4.0), pp. 17–18, 25–27, 35, https://www.doria.fi/bitstream/10024/195303/1/vj_2026-58_978-952-405-444-7.pdf, read 2026-10-30; Digitraffic infra-api laiturit (Väylävirasto / Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0) via /home/claude/packs_fi/FI-PM/_report.json and pieksamaki_platform_vayla.geojson, read 2026-10-30; https://www.vr.fi/rautatieasemat-ja-reitit/pieksamaki, read 2026-10-30; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pieks%C3%A4m%C3%A4ki_railway_station, read 2026-10-30

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts
answers.answer: Lifts from the tunnel to island 3/4, platform 6 (both in OSM) and platform 1 (inside the station building, not in OSM), per VR. Stairs at platform 1, island 3/4 and the east end (OSM; the 2020 plan says the tunnel stairs are not step-free).
